settings.heading: Elegance You Carry.
settings.text: Totes, crossbody bags, backpacks, duffles and pouches made for everyday life. Choose yours and order in a few taps.

settings.title: Order in a few taps
settings.text: Add bags to your cart, pay your way and we confirm your order with you.

settings.title: Five categories
settings.text: Handbags, crossbody bags, backpacks, duffles and pouches in one place.

settings.title: Built for daily use
settings.text: Strap anchors and handle bases are reinforced where bags usually fail.

settings.title: Custom requests
settings.text: Want a monogram or a different colour? Ask us before you order.

settings.title: Pick your bags
settings.text: Add bags to your cart and set the quantities.

settings.title: Check out
settings.text: Enter your name, phone, city and delivery address.

settings.title: Pay and confirm
settings.text: Pay with Easypaisa, JazzCash, NayaPay or bank transfer, or pay a 25% advance for cash on delivery. We confirm your order once we receive it.

settings.heading: Pay the way that suits you
settings.text: Choose a method at checkout. We confirm the total and the delivery date with you before you pay.

settings.title: Cash on delivery
settings.text: Pay a 25% advance by Easypaisa, JazzCash, NayaPay or bank transfer and send the payment screenshot. Your order is confirmed once the advance is received. Pay the remaining 75% in cash to the rider.

settings.title: Easypaisa
settings.text: Send the order total to our Easypaisa account, then send the payment screenshot.

settings.title: JazzCash
settings.text: Send the order total to our JazzCash account, then send the payment screenshot.

settings.title: NayaPay
settings.text: Send the order total to our NayaPay account, then send the payment screenshot.

settings.title: Bank transfer
settings.text: Transfer the order total to our bank account, then send the transfer receipt.
